name: Silverman's game
summary: Two-player zero-sum game where each picks a number to outbid the other but loses heavily if the ratio is too large.
rules_text: Before play, fix a set S of positive numbers, a threshold T>1 and penalty v>0. Simultaneously, player A chooses x in S and player B chooses y in S. Order them so x >= y. If x == y payoff to A is 0. If 1 < x/y < T payoff to A is 1. If x/y >= T payoff to A is -v. Payoff to B is the negative. Each player wants to choose a larger number than the opponent without exceeding the ratio T.
rating_reason: Two-player zero-sum choosing numbers from set with threshold payoff matrix.
